articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo doesn't understand anything: Why are Barça fans writing to her about Rodri?
articles.standfirst: The scene takes place after the midfielder's arrival at Barcelona and stems from an explanation that combines soccer, social media, and a coincidence of names.
articles.summary: The scene takes place after the midfielder's arrival at Barcelona and stems from an explanation that combines soccer, social media, and a coincidence of names.
articles.body:
The American singer unintentionally became a trending topic online after thousands of messages began appearing on one of her Instagram posts.

Barça fans took her latest post and began filling it with welcome messages. But not because of a song, her music, or her next concert, but to celebrate her arrival as the “new Barcelona player.”

The comments appeared on a post related to Smashing Pumpkins and had a very specific goal: to congratulate Rodri on his arrival at Barça . The scene drew attention for a fairly simple reason: What were the Blaugrana fans doing writing to an American pop star?

Olivia Rodrigo, an involuntary protagonist

The main response focuses on the fact that Rodri currently does not have social media. The footballer decided to stay away from Instagram, X, Snapchat , etc. Years ago he made the decision and does not have an official profile where people can leave him messages.

Given the footballer's absence from social media, some fans found an alternative as unexpected as it was funny: Olivia Rodrigo 's Instagram.

The pop star probably did not expect to receive messages from Barça fans talking about Rodri , but that was exactly what started happening on her latest Instagram post.

Although the singer already had a connection with the club, mainly because in May 2026 she was chosen by Spotify to feature on Barcelona 's jersey during El Clásico against Real Madrid . Her image replaced the platform's logo as part of the initiative that the club and Spotify carry out together with different artists. In addition, she became the youngest artist to take part in this action. However, the comments that have now appeared on her account are not related to that collaboration, but rather to the arrival of the Spanish footballer at Barça.

A situation that had already happened before

Elena G Durán was one of the people who explained through a video what was happening and, laughing, recalled that it is not the first time that the name Rodri has been involved in similar situations.

"When Rodri won the Ballon d'Or , his followers ran into the same problem: there was no official account where they could congratulate him. So, some looked for an alternative and ended up turning to Rodrigo De Paul 's Instagram.

The difference in this case is that they were not Rodri's followers, but mainly Vinícius/Real Madrid fans who were looking to confront him over the Ballon d'Or.

Why doesn't Rodri have social media?

It was the player himself who explained in an interview that he decided to stay off social media when he was still very young

“No tengo cuenta en Instagram, X, Snapchat. It was a decision I made when I was very young, although at that time it wasn’t normal at my age to have enough personality to say no”,

This is how, while the midfielder begins his new journey at Barcelona , Olivia encounters an amusing consequence: her Instagram filled with congratulations for joining the team.

articles.title: Ronaldinho lands in Italy for his presentation as Ravenna's new player
articles.standfirst: The club plays in Serie C
articles.summary: The club plays in Serie C
articles.body:
Ronaldinho Gaúcho landed this Thursday in Emilia-Romagna (Italy) to attend his presentation as the new Ravenna player , a Serie C team he signed for as part of a commercial strategy by the Italian club and with whom he is expected to play at least one official match .

The Brazilian star, who announced last June his return to professional football at the age of 46 with this team from northern Italy, landed at Forlì airport to be presented at the events organized by the Ravenna side on the occasion of the new season.

The club shared images on its social media of "Dinho" upon his arrival in Italy, showing the football legend making his iconic gesture , known as the "shaka," in which he raises his thumb and pinky while bending the other fingers toward the palm.

The Ballon d'Or winner and world champion with the Canarinha arrived in the Emilia-Romagna region on a flight from Milan, the team where he played for two and a half seasons, where he met with the Croatian Luka Modric, as the Brazilian himself showed on his social media.

Ronaldinho maintains a great relationship with the president, Ignazio Cipriani , an Italian businessman from the family that owns the Cipriani restaurant group, who acquired Ravenna in 2024 as a personal project and out of a strong bond with his hometown, with the aim of helping it grow.

The deal involving the legendary player has a clear international vocation and brand expansion focus, and is supported by partners such as Black Duck and by commercial agreements like the one signed with Nike.

The star is expected to play an official match with the Italian third-tier team, although the club has not yet revealed when his debut might take place.

At the player's official presentation almost two months ago, held in Miami (United States), Ronaldinho insisted that his main motivation continues to be the happiness that the ball gives him.

'"Football has always been joy for me, and I am excited to bring that spirit to Ravenna. Let the magic begin!", he said then.'

articles.title: Erling Haaland shocks the world as he finally cuts his iconic hair
articles.summary: Erling Haaland just took a major — and completely unexpected — step: he finally cut his hair.
articles.body:
Erling Haaland just took a major — and completely unexpected — step: he finally cut his hair.

The Norwegian striker had previously joked that he refused to cut it because, like Samson, his long hair was tied to his powers on the pitch.

But that myth is officially over as Haaland decided to say goodbye to his iconic mane.

His girlfriend was shaking as Haaland prepared to make the change without telling anyone in the family.

The moment he cut the first strand, she started crying. Knowing the haircut would be a huge surprise, Haaland FaceTimed Pep Guardiola, Zlatan Ibrahimović and even one of his best friends, Jack Grealish.

But it was Pep and Zlatan’s reactions that stole the spotlight.

Guardiola joked that Haaland was lucky to still have hair, while Zlatan took things to another level, telling him to delete his number.

articles.title: Unbelievable what happened to this “goalkeeper” will go down in history
articles.standfirst: Bobby Faulkner starred in one of the most unusual days in English football and ended up being key for Tranmere Rovers to salvage a draw against Port Vale.
articles.summary: Bobby Faulkner starred in one of the most unusual days in English football and ended up being key for Tranmere Rovers to salvage a draw against Port Vale.
articles.body:
"English football gave us one of those stories that seem straight out of a movie. Bobby Faulkner starred in one of the most peculiar stories of the matchday in English football.

Tranmere Rovers defender had to leave his usual position to put on the goalkeeper gloves for more than 50 minutes and ended up being key to salvaging a draw against Port Vale.

He put on the gloves and responded

Everything happened when Harrison Male, the starting goalkeeper, had to leave the match due to an injury at a time when his team did not have a substitute goalkeeper available for the same reason, and this was why Faulkner accepted the responsibility of taking over in goal.

The challenge for the defender was even greater because Tranmere Rovers were trailing 1-0 on the scoreboard when he had to put on the gloves. With no experience as a goalkeeper, Faulkner was tasked with preventing Port Vale from extending their lead for the remainder of the match.

What seemed like an emergency ended up working better than expected.

Far from suffering between the three posts, the footballer responded with several interventions to keep his goal from conceding any more goals.

For more than 50 minutes, he more than fulfilled a completely different role than usual and managed to keep his team in with a chance of coming back on the scoreboard.

His performance ended up being decisive for Tranmere Rovers , who managed to score the equalizer and salvage a point. Faulkner kept a clean sheet for the entire time he was in goal and prevented Port Vale from taking the lead again.

He put on the gloves and ended up being the star. Several saves and an aerial game that, to everyone's surprise, was up to the task... and even better than that of several goalkeepers around here.

articles.title: Ciro Messi looks every bit like his dad with stunning free kick before stealing the show with celebration
articles.standfirst: Lionel Messi's youngest son is only eight, but one spectacular goal and an ice-cold celebration made the family resemblance impossible to ignore
articles.summary: Lionel Messi's youngest son is only eight, but one spectacular goal and an ice-cold celebration made the family resemblance impossible to ignore
articles.body:
There are certain things that simply look familiar when the last name on the back of the shirt is Messi. Ciro Messi stepped up to a free kick for Inter Miami's academy, looked toward goal and produced the kind of moment his father has delivered countless times on much bigger stages.

The eight-year-old struck the ball with his right foot, sending it over the wall and beyond the goalkeeper during Inter Miami U8's run at the Dreams Cup. Unlike his famously left-footed father , Ciro is right-footed, but the confidence standing over a dead ball and the finish inevitably made comparisons with Lionel Messi impossible to avoid.

Then came the part nobody expected. After celebrating with his teammates, Ciro was handed a pair of sunglasses, put them on, crossed his arms and posed alongside the other children . The goal was impressive enough; the celebration made sure everyone remembered it.

Ciro Messi is beginning to create moments of his own

Being Lionel Messi's son means almost anything Ciro does with a football will be compared with his father, but the youngster is already giving people plenty to talk about on his own. Inter Miami went on to win the Dreams Cup, crushing Weston FC 10-2 in the final, with Ciro scoring twice before being named MVP. He also finished the tournament as its leading scorer.

Ciro isn't the only Messi growing up with a ball at his feet. His older brothers Thiago and Mateo are also part of Inter Miami's youth system , allowing all three boys to develop at the same club where their father continues to add chapters to one of football's greatest careers.

Nobody knows where football will eventually take an eight-year-old boy, and comparisons with perhaps the greatest player ever are a burden Ciro certainly doesn't need yet. For now, he is simply playing, scoring and having fun. But when a Messi curls in a beautiful free kick and then celebrates in sunglasses like he owns the place, asking fans not to think about his father becomes almost impossible.

articles.title: Former teammate breaks silence on what Cristiano Ronaldo is really like behind closed doors
articles.standfirst: Álvaro González was with the Portuguese in Saudi Arabia
articles.summary: Álvaro González was with the Portuguese in Saudi Arabia
articles.body:
" lvaro González was asked during the broadcast of Racing-Elche on Radio MARCA about his experience sharing a locker room with Cristiano Ronaldo . The former Spanish footballer crossed paths with the Portuguese star in Saudi Arabia and was able to learn firsthand what it is like to live alongside one of the greatest stars in football history.

Álvaro's response was emphatic. "Honestly, and after confirming it with other teammates we’ve had in common, he’s a true phenomenon in the dressing room" , explained the former center-back.

A perception that, according to him, changes radically when Cristiano steps onto the pitch. "As soon as he goes from the dressing room to the field, he completely changes" , he assured. For Álvaro, the Portuguese forward is "a competitive beast" when it comes time to compete.

Far from that image of maximum demands, Álvaro described Cristiano as a very different person in everyday life. "Inside the dressing room he is a super normal, approachable person who helps you" , he said during the broadcast.

In fact, he especially recalled the role the Portuguese player played when he arrived. "He helped us enormously when he arrived because of some things that were happening during that year, and he helped us with everything" , he explained.

Inside the locker room Cristiano is a super normal, down-to-earth person who helps you

For Álvaro, getting to know that side of the Portuguese star up close was one of the great experiences he took away from his time in Saudi Arabia. "When you experience it firsthand yourself, it’s much more beautiful" , he admitted.

The former footballer also highlighted having shared a dressing room with players of the stature of Cristiano and Messi. "They are people, both he and Messi, who will go down in the history of sport, which is football" , he stated.

During the conversation there was also room for jokes about training sessions. Asked whether he dared to "get under Cristiano's skin," Álvaro did not hide: "Always" .

Of course, any tension was quickly forgotten. "The dirty looks... afterwards we would go to the jacuzzi, have a few laughs and some humor, and everything would pass" , he said with a laugh.

Cristiano demands to compete

Álvaro believes that competitiveness in training was also important for Cristiano himself, especially when arriving in a different kind of football from the European one. "He likes us to be competitive in training" , he explained.

The Portuguese wanted to maintain that high standard despite the change of setting and was clear that he had to "keep going here and keep at it because we have to carry on" , especially with one goal on the horizon: "Him, to reach one thousand goals" .

articles.title: The 200 million pushing Benzema out of Al Hilal... and into retirement?
articles.standfirst: The former Madrid player is close to terminating his contract after the Saudi club's galactic signings
articles.summary: The former Madrid player is close to terminating his contract after the Saudi club's galactic signings
articles.body:
“I will stay at Al Hilal” , assured Karim Benzema last August 21, after beating Al Fayha (0-3) . However, the former Real Madrid player, signed from Al Ittihad in February, seems to have his days numbered at the Kingdom Arena .

The team managed by Simone Inzaghi is pushing him to leave after spending 205.87 million euros on signings. To the 64.5 million paid for Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) and the 58.4 million paid for Ollie Watkins must be added the 70 they are going to shell out for Gabriel Martinelli .

That without counting the 7.67 it has paid for Mohammed Mahzari (Al Taawoun) , the 3 that Mohamed Al Sarnukh cost, and the 2.3 for Sabri Dahal (Al Fayha) . In addition, Mohammed Al Owais (Al Ula) and Abdullah Al Anazi (Al Fateh) have arrived on free transfers.

The arrivals of Summerville, Watkins and Martinelli and the presence of eight other foreigners ( Yassine Bounou, Yusuf Akçiçek, Kalidou Koulibaly, Theo Hernandez, Rúben Neves, Sergej Milinkovic-Savic, Saïmon Bouabré and Kader Meïté ) threatened to leave Benzema without a roster spot in the Saudi League . He would only be allowed to take part in the Asian Champions League .

A complicated situation that could have an imminent solution . Al Hilal and Benzema are close to reaching an agreement to terminate the contract that binds them until next June 30 .

From there, the future of the 38-year-old French forward is a complete unknown. In principle, the former Real Madrid player has a contract with the Saudi League until 2030, which has fueled the possibility that he could sign for Al Shabab... or return to Al Ittihad.

Fabrizio Romano rules out his return to the Old Continent, including a comeback to Olympique Lyonnais, the club that launched him to fame and where he has always said he would like to return. "Benzema will soon announce his decision about his future; among the options are retirement or playing for another Saudi club . He will not return to Europe," emphasizes Fabrizio Romano.

Retirement is also a viable option. If he were to hang up his boots, he would leave behind 895 matches, 484 goals and 205 assists during his time at Olympique de Lyon (2004-09), Real Madrid (2009-23), Al Ittihad (2023-26) and Al Hilal (2026). In addition to 97 caps and 37 goals with France. A possible move to Major League Soccer (MLS) should not be ruled out either.

articles.title: "We will love you until the end of our days": Messi announced his retirement and the reactions arrived
articles.standfirst: Admiration, gratitude, and emotion to bid farewell to Leo, who for two decades made the extraordinary seem simple.
articles.summary: Admiration, gratitude, and emotion to bid farewell to Leo, who for two decades made the extraordinary seem simple.
articles.body:
This Monday, Lionel Messi announced his retirement from the Argentine National Team after 20 years. The legendary captain and greatest icon of the Albiceleste shared a letter and an emotional video on his Instagram account explaining the reasons for his decision and revisiting the most important moments of his career.

"After this time that has passed since the final, after thinking about it a lot, I want to let everyone know that I am retiring from the National Team," he wrote at the beginning of the letter that broke the hearts of the millions of Argentinians who follow him.

The messages from his teammates after the announcement

While millions of fans were processing news that seemed impossible to imagine, there was one group that experienced the announcement from an even more intimate place: his teammates.

The footballers who shared training camps, locker rooms, defeats, and the most glorious nights in the recent history of Argentina began leaving him messages on social media almost immediately.

Rodrigo De Paul , one of the footballers closest to the Argentine captain, with whom he built a very close relationship on and off the pitch, dedicated some heartfelt farewell words to him, highlighted Messi 's love for Argentina, the struggles he went through throughout his career, his leadership within the group and, especially, his human quality, both with his teammates and with each of the workers who are part of the National Team. In his message, he summed up that bond with a forceful phrase: “Only thanks, the greatest in all of history.” And, toward the end, he left him one last show of gratitude: “Thank you for making us so, so happy [...] You are eternal"

Ángel Di María , who shared with Messi a good part of his most important years wearing the Argentina jersey and who had already closed his own chapter with the National Team after the 2024 Copa América , was also among the first to react. Fideo chose to thank Messi for something that goes beyond soccer: for choosing to represent Argentina when he could have taken another path. “Thank you, Captain. Thank you for everything. The best in history” , he wrote.

Enzo Fernández built his farewell from the perspective of that boy who dreamed of one day sharing the Argentina shirt with Messi. He recalled that, when the captain had first announced that he was stepping away from the National Team, he used to calculate his own age and Leo’s to imagine whether he would still have time to reach the top division and cross paths with his idol. Life, in the end, was far more generous: he not only managed to play alongside him, but also shared training camps, the dressing room, conversations, and difficult moments with him until becoming a world champion together with him. But Enzo chose to highlight, above all, the way Messi welcomed him from the moment he arrived: “I found a person who, from the very first moment, made me feel like one of the group” . “How lucky I was, Leo” , he wrote toward the end, before admitting that it is hard for him to imagine the next training camp without seeing him ahead of him, wearing the number 10. “We’re going to miss you a lot, captain.”

“My daughter is going to be proud that I was able to share a team with you”

One of the most personal messages was Lisandro Martínez's. The defender put into words something that surely many footballers of the new generation feel: having made it to the National Team dreaming of playing alongside Messi and ending up also discovering the person behind the idol. “My daughter is going to be very proud that her father shared a team with an extraordinary human being,” he wrote, before defining him as an example “in football and in life.”

The rest of the world champion squad also made their voices heard.

Lautaro Martínez chose a brief but forceful message: "Eternally grateful, captain". Alexis Mac Allister, for his part, thanked Messi for the impact he had on the current generation of Argentine footballers: "Thank you for everything you gave us on and off the field".

Leandro Paredes posted a carousel of photos in which he thanked him for everything he did for him as an Argentine, as a fan of the National Team, as a teammate, and as a friend. They were joined by the stories from Cristian "Cuti" Romero and Nicolás Tagliafico, who, on his birthday, also dedicated a few words to the one he described as his idol.

Other voices in the locker room chose to highlight different aspects of the captain's legacy. Goalkeeper Guillermo Rulli emphasized that Messi is eternal not only for what he gave as a player, but because he showed them the path of resilience, hard work, and camaraderie.

Giovanni Lo Celso for his part said that his legacy will be eternal and thanked him for teaching them so much and guiding them on and off the field.

The AFA , through the official Argentina national team account, joined the tribute with an image of the captain lifting the World Cup and a message that summed up the general feeling: "Thank you forever, Leo. We will love you until the end of our days".

Antonela's message and the pain of a farewell that transcends soccer

His wife and mother of his children, Antonela Roccuzzo, dedicated some tender words to Messi after the announcement of his retirement: "How proud to have been by your side on this journey and to see you fulfill all your dreams. You deserved this story and so much more. We love you infinitely."

Messi is leaving the National Team after a story that had painful defeats, criticism, a first farewell in 2016, and a return that ended up changing everything and making him the greatest source of pride for all Argentinians.

articles.title: "How hard it is to read that we’re not going to see you anymore...": Di María’s emotional message to Messi
articles.standfirst: Fideo put into words a feeling that surely millions of Argentinians share: the difficulty of imagining the national team without Messi.
articles.summary: Fideo put into words a feeling that surely millions of Argentinians share: the difficulty of imagining the national team without Messi.
articles.body:
The announcement of Lionel Messi retiring from the Argentina national team triggered an avalanche of reactions. Among the millions of messages from fans and football figures, there was one that had special meaning: that of Ángel Di María.

Both footballers shared a generation, went through defeats that seemed endless and, finally, had the opportunity to change the history of the National Team forever.

The full message from Di María to Messi

With the announcement of Messi 's retirement, Fideo's message took on a special meaning: it was not only the farewell of a teammate, but that of one of the protagonists of a story that both built over nearly two decades.

“How hard it is to read that you are retiring, how hard it is to read that we are not going to see you anymore in the sky blue and white. I only know that I was born in the right century to be able to see you, enjoy you, and on top of that be able to share with you all these years with the national team. To see you fulfill all your dreams and the most desired one, which was to be world champion. Today you decided to take that step that surely neither you nor all Argentines wanted to come. But it came, and today as always we are going to say to you many, many thanks for everything. You are eternal and the best in all of HISTORY. 💙💙💙”

The words of Di María reflect a relationship that went through virtually every possible stage with the Argentine jersey. They shared frustrations and painful defeats, but they also experienced together the definitive transformation of a generation that ended up conquering America and the world.

That is why, more than a simple “thank you” , Di María’s message works as the closing of a chapter that for years seemed impossible to end like this.

articles.title: Lionel Messi retires from the Argentina national team leaving behind a historic thorn he could never remove
articles.standfirst: There is an unfinished score to settle against the greatest powers on the planet that will accompany his legacy forever
articles.summary: There is an unfinished score to settle against the greatest powers on the planet that will accompany his legacy forever
articles.body:
'Throughout 21 years of career wearing the jersey of Argentina 's senior national team, Lionel Messi took it upon himself to rewrite all the history books of world football . However, even the most brilliant and decorated career of all time left one small box unchecked that powerfully draws the attention of analysts .'

The Rosario-born star never managed to score a single goal in an official match against five of the biggest powers in international soccer : Brazil, Germany, Italy, Spain, and England. This curious statistical anomaly remains a singular fact within an international career that ended with a staggering 207 official appearances and 125 goals to his name .

The thorn lodged against the eternal South American rival

Of all the powerhouses he failed to score against in official matches, the drought against the Brazil national team is undoubtedly the one that carries the greatest weight in any analysis of his career . The intense historic rivalry between Argentina and the Canarinha turned every South American superclásico into the ideal stage for the captain to leave his mark on the scoresheet .

Although the Rosario forward had multiple opportunities to come face to face with the Brazilian squad—even in the most demanding settings such as World Cup qualifiers and Copa América tournaments— that goal in a full official match never ended up coming , remaining as a curious outstanding mark on his personal record .

A giant legacy that overshadows any minor statistic

Despite that unfinished business against the five-time world champions, that record does not take away a single ounce of brilliance from the gigantic impact he generated in international football . The "10" bids farewell to the Albiceleste holding the all-time records for top scorer, player with the most appearances, leader in wins, and top assist provider with 68 goal passes .

Likewise, his performances in the World Cups broke new ground by amassing 34 matches played and scoring in five different editions of the international tournament . Among his most notable records on the world stage is having become the oldest footballer to score a hat trick in a World Cup , in addition to a total of 12 assists in the competition , ten of them in direct knockout rounds.

The end of the drought and the definitive consecration

Messi's journey with the national team was marked for years by moments of extremely high tension and bitterness . After losing in the 2016 Copa América Centenario final against Chile —which represented Argentina's third consecutive lost final—, the forward made the drastic decision to temporarily retire from the national team, overwhelmed by the pressure .

However, his subsequent return radically changed the course of Argentine football by leading one of the country's most glorious eras . In 2021, he ended a 28-year title drought by lifting the Copa América, an achievement he repeated in 2024, after reaching the pinnacle of world football by being crowned champion at the 2022 Qatar World Cup to bring an end to 36 years of waiting.

The definitive farewell after an unforgettable era

On this occasion there will not be a second return for the "10" on the international stage, following the defeat suffered against Spain in the 2026 World Cup final. According to reports from EssentiallySports, the footballer himself drafted his official farewell message just a couple of days after the final , a decision that was definitively cemented after the sad passing of his father, Jorge Messi, which occurred a few weeks later .

At 39 years old, the star will remain focused on his club career wearing the Inter Miami jersey in Major League Soccer , leaving an irreplaceable void in the Argentine locker room. Although the fact that he never scored against Brazil in an official match remains a singular anecdote, his name is etched at the pinnacle of the sport after more than two decades of absolute dominance .

articles.standfirst: While the world of football was shaken by the farewell of the Rosario star, CR7's response on his social media left no one indifferent
articles.summary: While the world of football was shaken by the farewell of the Rosario star, CR7's response on his social media left no one indifferent
articles.body:
'The world soccer experienced a historic day with the announcement that brought millions of fans across the planet to a standstill. Lionel Messi confirmed the end of his glorious era with the Argentina National Team after more than two decades wearing the national jersey, a golden period in which he won the World Cup and forever transformed the history of international soccer .'

Reactions quickly flooded digital platforms, where teammates, coaches, and figures from various sports dedicated heartfelt words of tribute to the Rosario-born star . However, the attention of the press and the fans was focused on one voice in particular: that of his great generational rival, Cristiano Ronaldo .

Far from joining the wave of direct messages or melancholic statements about the Argentine's departure, the Portuguese forward chose a much colder stance focused strictly on his daily work .

The enigmatic post that sparked the debate

According to the specialized outlet Bolavip, Cristiano Ronaldo's first public statement after the news was confirmed came through his official channels from Saudi Arabia . The Al-Nassr forward shared a photograph in which he is seen training in the club's gym, accompanied by the phrase in English: "Keep pushing" ("Sigue empujando").

This brief reappearance was interpreted by analysts and fans as an indirect message about his own competitive stance . While Messi is closing out his international chapter to face the final years of his career, the Portuguese star reaffirms his intention to remain at the highest level without showing any signs of a near retirement from the Portuguese national team .

Various international media outlets and portals such as N+ have highlighted how CR7’s figure continues to command the spotlight on a global scale . Neither the multimillion-dollar market transactions nor the emergence of young prospects in the major leagues have managed to overshadow the Portuguese star’s media impact , reaffirmed as one of the most powerful phenomena in today’s sports world.

Cristiano Ronaldo's continuity in the Portuguese national team raises a recurring conversation within the "Seleção" environment . Unlike Argentina, which is beginning a planned transition after the farewell of its greatest icon, in Portugal there is debate over whether the team should continue being built around the experienced forward or make way definitively for a new generation of footballers.

The contrast between the two trajectories reflects the different philosophies with which the two greatest legends of the 21st century approach the final stretch of their sporting careers . While Messi steps aside to prioritize renewal in his national team, Cristiano remains firmly focused on the upcoming international commitments in Europe.

articles.title: Messi's mother's moving message after his farewell to the National Team: "I'm still crying, it all happened at once"
articles.standfirst: The mother of the Argentine star broke her silence after the retirement of the captain of the Argentina National Team was confirmed, following more than two decades in the international elite
articles.summary: The mother of the Argentine star broke her silence after the retirement of the captain of the Argentina National Team was confirmed, following more than two decades in the international elite
articles.body:
The announcement of Lionel Messi confirming his definitive farewell to the Argentina National Team has caused a genuine emotional earthquake in the football world . After more than two decades wearing the albiceleste jersey and after playing his last international match in the final of the 2026 World Cup against Spain , the Rosario-born captain decided to bring the most glorious chapter of his sporting career to an end.

The news, although it was something that had been taking shape in the footballer's private life after mulling over the decision with his closest circle , generated an immediate impact on global sport . However, the hardest and most heartbreaking blow is being felt within the four walls of the Messi family, where coming to terms with this farewell is proving to be an extremely painful process .

It was the Inter Miami player's own mother, Celia María Cuccittini , who decided to step forward publicly to express the feelings overwhelming the "10"'s closest inner circle . In an emotional conversation with the Argentine outlet América TV, she did not hide the heartbreak and sadness that have dominated her days since the star's letter became public on social media .

Unceasing crying and the memory of Jorge

"I'm watching them and I'm still crying. Although we already knew, the whole family is very sad , but the important thing is that he be happy ," Celia Cuccittini confessed during the television interview. With these words, the captain's mother reflected the bitterness reigning in the household after the formal announcement , confirming that the prior preparation did not soften the harshness of the moment.

In the midst of her statements, the footballer's mother opened her heart to reveal a moving detail involving her husband Jorge Messi. Celia recalled the concern that for years had lingered in the player's father's mind about the moment when the boots would finally be hung up .

'"Dad would always say: "What am I going to do when I don’t play anymore?" . And it all happened at once, unbelievable," Celia Cuccittini revealed with evident nostalgia to América TV. This premonitory phrase made clear the cumulative impact the family is experiencing at a stage marked by intense personal and professional experiences .'

The emotional statement that brought the world to a standstill

The trigger for these reactions was the moving letter released by Lionel Messi himself to make official the end of his time with the national team . In his message, the Rosario-born star explained that, although the decision hurt him deeply, he felt that the time had come to step aside .

"I swear to you that I always gave everything, not just in the last few years, when everything was won, but before that as well. I always fought and gave everything for this jersey , to give you joy and make you feel proud to be Argentine through soccer," stated the "Flea" in the writing that moved millions of fans.

The former FC Barcelona footballer also argued that the generational смена is an unavoidable reality . He acknowledged that he feels completely drained when it comes to international tournaments and that it is the perfect time for the young talents who have been pushing hard to take his place in the squad .

The unbeatable numbers of a legend

Messi's departure puts the finishing touch on a legendary journey that began on August 17, 2005 in that memorable friendly against Hungary. From that fateful debut, when he was sent off after just a few seconds, the Rosario-born star built an unparalleled career with 207 matches played, 125 goals, and 68 assists while wearing the colors of his homeland.

Over the course of 20 years, the attacker managed to reverse years of disappointments and harsh criticism until leading Argentina into the most prosperous era of its recent history . The Copa América titles, the Finalissima, and the iconic triumph at the 2022 Qatar World Cup remain etched in the collective memory of the beautiful game.

The media impact and the irreplaceable void

Various international media outlets such as the newspaper Sport, the radio station Cadena 3, or the portal La Popu have echoed this historic farewell . All of them agree in pointing out that the captain's departure leaves a void that goes beyond the merely tactical or sporting to become a cultural event .

The figure of the Rosario native has marked several generations of fans who saw in him the greatest standard-bearer of world football . Commentators and analysts have compared the significance of his figure to the greatest icons of art , highlighting his ability to generate happiness almost in silence and solely through the ball.

As the Argentina National Team begins the search for a new path without its number 10 shirt, Celia Cuccittini’s heartfelt words capture the feelings of an entire country . The farewell of the king of football leaves an indelible mark and a family-like melancholy that will take a long time to fade .

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo's son caught Georgina Rodriguez off guard mid flight in private jet
articles.standfirst: An unexpected moment during a flight ended up revealing Georgina’s special bond with Cristiano Ronaldo’s son and a much more intimate side of the family.
articles.summary: An unexpected moment during a flight ended up revealing Georgina’s special bond with Cristiano Ronaldo’s son and a much more intimate side of the family.
articles.body:
Not everything that happens around Georgina Rodríguez has to do with major events, trips, or moments in front of the cameras. There are also those much simpler scenes that happen without warning and end up showing a different side of her life. During a flight, while she was sharing a few details with her followers, one of those moments ended up catching particular attention.

It all began when Georgina talked about the dress she was wearing and how she had looked in the recordings she was making. For a moment, she even hesitated as she tried to describe herself, saying, “I looked like a…” before pausing . The sentence was left hanging, but Cristiano Ronaldo Jr. , who was there, decided to continue the conversation.

His response was short, direct, and probably much sweeter than Georgina expected: “A queen.”

The reaction around them was immediate. Expressions of surprise and affection could be heard as Georgina received the compliment in an atmosphere of complicity that made the moment even more special. Shortly afterward, she explained why she wasn’t surprised to receive those kinds of words from her son: “Chris always takes care of me. He’s the one who compliments me the most.” And yes, the moment had that little touch that makes you smile: while she was trying to describe how she looked, he simply decided to remind her of how he sees her.

Georgina is having her own moment

Beyond that family moment, the video comes at a time when Georgina is also dedicating much of her time to her own projects. At the beginning of 2026, she launched Mimoa, her women’s sportswear brand, and her recent posts show that the label has gradually become part of her everyday life . In one of her latest Instagram Stories, for example, she appeared wearing capri pants, a brown top, a white jacket, sunglasses, and a handbag, combining pieces from her brand with accessories from other labels.

And perhaps what is most interesting is that her public life has not been limited to just one version of herself. She can appear surrounded by fashion and luxury, but she can also share moments with her children or show small details from her daily routine.

Meanwhile, as she continues building that space of her own, Cristiano Ronaldo is going through a decisive stage in his football career. The Al-Nassr forward recently reached 104 goals in the Saudi Pro League, surpassed Mohammed Al-Sahlawi’s record, and moved to within 22 goals of reaching 1,000 official career goals .

But amid all those records and experiences, that moment on the jet ended up showing something much more personal: the bond they share as a family.

articles.title: When Diego Maradona sent a young Lionel Messi running from one side of the field to the other
articles.standfirst: Sixteen years before his retirement, Argentina’s future No. 10 was still learning from the man he idolized
articles.summary: Sixteen years before his retirement, Argentina’s future No. 10 was still learning from the man he idolized
articles.body:
D iego Maradona sends the ball toward one side of the field and Lionel Messi runs after it. Messi controls it, returns the pass and then has to move again when Maradona sends the ball in another direction. There is no formal competition between them, just Argentina’s coach personally warming up the young player expected to inherit his legendary No. 10.

The footage was recorded during the 2010 World Cup in South Africa, 16 years before Messi announced his retirement from Argentina. He began that tournament at 22 and turned 23 during the competition. Messi had already won his first Ballon d’Or and was a superstar with Barcelona, but he had not yet become the national hero who would finally deliver Argentina’s greatest trophies.

Diego Maradona and Lionel Messi shared Argentina’s No. 10 for almost two years

Maradona coached Messi with Argentina for almost two years, from late 2008 until the end of the 2010 World Cup. Together they survived a difficult qualifying campaign and won their first four matches in South Africa before Germany eliminated them 4-0 in the quarterfinals.

They never won a trophy together, but Maradona publicly defended Messi and even personally helped him improve the free kicks that would later become one of his greatest weapons.

As players, their international careers defined two generations. Maradona represented Argentina from 1977 to 1994, scoring 34 goals in 91 appearances and leading the country to the 1986 World Cup title and the 1990 final.

Messi played for the senior team from 2005 to 2026 and retired with national records of 207 appearances and 125 goals, along with the 2022 World Cup, the 2021 and 2024 Copa América titles and the 2022 Finalissima.

Sixteen years after that simple passing drill, Maradona is gone and Messi has officially played his final match for Argentina. The young player, once running from side to side for his idol, eventually carried the same No. 10, lifted the World Cup and completed a journey that had always been measured against Maradona’s.

What once looked like an ordinary warm-up now feels like the moment one era quietly handed the ball to the next. And as Messi’s era begins to say goodbye, one question remains: who will he pass the ball to?

The young player, once running from side to side for his idol, eventually carried the same No. 10, lifted the World Cup and completed a journey that had always been measured against Maradona’s.

What once looked like an ordinary warm-up now feels like the moment one era quietly handed the ball to the next. And as Messi’s era begins to say goodbye, one question remains: who will he pass the ball to?

articles.title: The soccer ranking that brings together the biggest stars: Neymar, Mbappé, and the most expensive transfers in history
articles.standfirst: Football has been generating multimillion-dollar figures for years because of its big stars, but a deal made in 2017 remains on another level.
articles.summary: Football has been generating multimillion-dollar figures for years because of its big stars, but a deal made in 2017 remains on another level.
articles.body:
The 222 million euros that Paris Saint-Germain paid Barcelona for Neymar seemed to belong to another era of football. The Brazilian left Camp Nou in August 2017 and set a record that still remains at the top of the most expensive transfers in history.

The market picked up speed again in 2025 and 2026, bringing about new extraordinary figures with names like Kylian Mbappé, Ousmane Dembélé, Alexander Isak and several Premier League protagonists who continue to occupy the top spots.

Figures that still could not be reached

The top spot, as we indicated earlier, still belongs to the historic signing of Neymar by Paris Saint-Germain, who bought the player from Barcelona in exchange for 222 million euros, a figure that forever transformed the scale of football’s major transfers.

Second place belongs to Kylian Mbappé . The French forward joined Paris Saint-Germain permanently from Monaco for 180 million euros, in a deal that was completed in 2018.

Ousmane Dembélé , whose transfer from Borussia Dortmund to Barcelona was valued at 148 million euros, is another of the players who appears in the top positions.

Another of the standout names is Enzo Fernández , whose transfer ranks among the highest on the list with a figure of 145 million euros. The Argentine had managed to attract international attention after his breakthrough in Europe and his rise to prominence with the Argentine national team, being chosen as the breakout player of the 2022 World Cup, where he was crowned world champion.

The new generation driving the ranking

Alexander Isak arrived at Liverpool from Newcastle for a fee close to 145 million euros, while Elliot Anderson reached 135 million in his move to Manchester City. The phenomenon is not limited to an isolated deal. Morgan Rogers moved from Aston Villa to Chelsea for around 138 million euros, while Florian Wirtz and other footballers also settled in the 125-million range.

Even with this new wave of major investments, the Brazilian's record still holds a considerable gap. For this reason, the record continues to belong to the star who emerged at Santos; however, the question that arises is: How much longer will Neymar be able to remain at number one?

articles.title: Lamine Yamal turns heads with elevated style alongside Inés García at AFE Gala
articles.summary: Fans have been paying close attention to the changes in Lamine Yamal’s style since he started dating Inés García, with many noting that the Barcelona star’s wardrobe has become more elevated, elegant, and polished.
articles.body:
Fans have been paying close attention to the changes in Lamine Yamal’s style since he started dating Inés García, with many noting that the Barcelona star’s wardrobe has become more elevated, elegant, and polished.

That was once again on display at the AFE Gala, where Yamal received the award for Best Player of the 2025-26 season and turned heads with his outfit.

He wore black trousers, a dress shirt and tie, finished with a beige bomber jacket that complemented the look perfectly. Inés, meanwhile, opted for a simple yet elegant straight satin white dress that elevated her style while also matching Yamal’s look.

Yamal is also continuing to grow his beard and mustache as part of his promise after winning the World Cup, and while the challenge has clearly changed his usual look, fans agree that he is pulling it off and could consider keeping it.

articles.title: Ester Expósito sparks Real Madrid fan backlash after being spotted smoking
articles.summary: Ester Expósito is once again under the close watch of some jealous Real Madrid fans, who seem to follow every move the actress makes or doesn’t make.
articles.body:
Ester Expósito is once again under the close watch of some jealous Real Madrid fans, who seem to follow every move the actress makes or doesn’t make.

After facing heavy criticism from fans following Kylian Mbappé’s defeat against Spain at the World Cup, Ester has continued to be part of the conversation surrounding the French star’s performances.

Now, she is drawing attention for a much more personal moment after being spotted smoking a cigarette on the streets at night.

Some of the more demanding fans were quick to express their frustration, worrying that the actress could pass the habit on to Mbappé.

It may sound exaggerated, but that was enough for some supporters to question Ester’s behavior and turn another off-field moment into a talking point surrounding the Real Madrid star.

articles.title: Benzema, Sergio Ramos, Icardi and the stars left without a club after the close of the European transfer window
articles.standfirst: The European soccer transfer window has come to an end, but the market is still not completely closed. More than 10 renowned footballers remain without a team and, as free agents, can still find a new destination despite the closure of the major leagues.
articles.summary: The European soccer transfer window has come to an end, but the market is still not completely closed. More than 10 renowned footballers remain without a team and, as free agents, can still find a new destination despite the closure of the major leagues.
articles.body:
The close of the European market usually puts the finishing touch on weeks of rumors, negotiations, and last-minute deals. However, several renowned footballers are still without a team and still keep open the possibility of finding a new destination for a season that has just begun.

What stands out is that players of the caliber of Benzema, Sergio Ramos, or Icardi have reached this point without a team, which breaks with fans’ usual perception of big stars. It creates a mix of surprise, uncertainty, and nostalgia. Who will be the first to find a new destination?

Stars still waiting for a new destination

England, Spain, Italy, Germany, and France closed the transfer market on September 1, finalizing their main moves and also leaving several renowned footballers without a club. Karim Benzema, Sergio Ramos, Dani Carvajal, Paul Pogba, Riyad Mahrez, Jadon Sancho, David Alaba, and Mauro Icardi are the most well-known and standout athletes who are still searching for their new club.

Carvajal arrives on this list with six Champions League titles won with Real Madrid. Benzema, meanwhile, was awarded the Ballon d'Or in 2022 and is even considering the possibility of retirement after terminating his contract with Al Hilal.

Joselu Mato, Pedro Rodríguez and Sergio Ramos are also among the experienced players whose futures are still undefined. None of them has announced their retirement, and their careers still carry significant weight in European football. The latter won 22 titles with Real Madrid, 4 titles with the Spanish national team, one of them being the World Cup, and 3 titles with Paris Saint-Germain, a tremendous career, an experience that any team would want to have.

Philippe Coutinho , at 34 years old, is currently without a team. In January 2018, FC Barcelona paid Liverpool around 120 million euros fixed, making him the most expensive signing in the club's history; in 2019-20 he was loaned to Bayern Munich , where he was crowned European champion. His career then began to drift away from the top level and currently, after spending time at Vasco da Gama, the club where he developed, he is waiting for a new contract.

Pogba , world champion with France in 2018 and one of the most important midfielders of his generation, returned to Juventus in 2022 after his spell at Manchester United . But his second stint in Turin was marked by injuries and, later, by a positive testosterone test that ended with an 18-month suspension for doping. Juventus terminated his contract in November 2024.

In 2025, AS Monaco took a chance on him and offered him a contract until June 2027, but that did not work out either. During the 2025-26 season, he played only six matches, with injuries as his main obstacle. The club and the player terminated the contract by mutual agreement on August 19, 2026. At 33 years old, the Frenchman is once again without a team.

Although the transfer window may be over, out-of-contract players do not need two clubs to negotiate a transfer in order to join a new team. However, their chances of competing immediately in certain European tournaments may depend on the registration deadlines set by UEFA , a detail that could prove decisive for some of these footballers.

Icardi arrived in Istanbul in 2022 on loan from PSG and, after a respectable first season, Galatasaray bought him for around 10 million euros. Over four seasons he became one of the club’s greatest recent idols: he played 134 matches, scored 77 goals, and won four Turkish league titles, one Turkish Cup, and one Super Cup. In addition, he was the league’s top scorer in 2023-24 with 25 goals.

After a serious knee injury and the arrival of Victor Osimhen, negotiations to renew his contract became more complicated and his ties with Galatasaray ended on June 30, 2026. The club confirmed his departure in July, leaving as an idol, but he still has to prove that he remains decisive in order to play at the highest level.

The close of the European summer transfer window ended this Tuesday with Enzo Fernández as the main protagonist after becoming the most expensive signing in Premier League history once Manchester City paid around 145 million euros. The question now is which of these names will be the first to show that, even with the window closed, there are still transfers capable of surprising football.
